armyRules.name: Entrenched Obstinacy
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion digs in and does not leave. A unit with this rule that did not move in its last Movement phase adds 1 to its Toughness against Shooting Attacks, but it may not Rush, and it subtracts 1 from its Charge rolls.
armyRules.condition: against Shooting Attacks, if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

armyRules.name: Methodical Barrage
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The guns work through a target in order, and are slow to turn on a new one. A unit with this rule adds 1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks against a unit that is Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned, but it subtracts 1 from its Hit Tests against any unit that Rushed in its last turn.
armyRules.condition: against a Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned unit

armyRules.name: Siege-Plate Hulls
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Iron Warriors armour is built for the long approach, not the race. A vehicle with this rule adds 1 to its Front armour value but loses 1 Movement.

wargear.name: Fortification kit
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Spades, sandbag lattices and quick-setting ferrocrete foam, hauled across every battlefield and used on all of them. The unit gains Shrouded (6+), and every model suffers -1 Movement.

wargear.name: Bastion rangefinder
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tripod-mounted ranging array and a gunner who has never missed a measurement. The unit gains +1 Ballistic Skill, but only when it did not move this turn.

wargear.name: Mechanicum augmetics
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Bionic limbs and subdermal plating, grafted in by the Legion's own sawbones. The model gains +1 Toughness and suffers -1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Demolition satchel
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A satchel of shaped charges carried to the walls the Legion means to open. Gives the model Shaped Charge.

wargear.name: Bastion standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A banner on an iron pole, hammered into the ground so that charging enemies must come to it. Gives the unit Unyielding Bastion.

wargear.name: Ablative bulwark plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Layered ceramite slabs that peel away rather than break. Gives the model Ablative Layers.

wargear.name: Siege-ledger
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cogitator slate of ranges, wall thicknesses and failure points. Gives the model Siege Calculus.

wargear.name: Sapper's tunnelling kit
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Augers, props and spades for going under a line rather than over it. Gives the unit Sapper Tunnels.

wargear.name: Spall liners
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Quilted ablative sheeting packed behind the hull plates. Gives the vehicle Spall Liners.

wargear.name: Fixed-fire core
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A machine-spirit cogitation core tuned for patience and aim. Gives the automaton Fixed-Fire Protocol.

modifiers.text: Drilled to the wall: +1 LD, -1 I.

modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move this turn

modifiers.text: Spall liners: ignores Stunned and Suppressed from Shooting Attacks.
Fixed-fire core: +1 BS if it did not move.
modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move this turn

rules.name: Dug In
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Bastion Doctrine). A unit with this rule that did not move in its last Movement phase counts as being in Cover against Shooting Attacks and adds +1 to its Cool Checks until it moves again.

rules.name: Unbroken Garrison
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Iron Circle Garrison). The Tyrant's guard does not break. While within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith, a unit with this rule automatically passes Cool Checks and Pinning Checks, and it may never voluntarily Fall Back.

rules.name: Machine Certainty
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Cold Calculus). The automata feel no dread. A unit with this rule ignores the effects of Fear (X) and cannot be Pinned.

rules.name: Through the Breach
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Breach and Clear). Siege infantry go through the walls rather than around them. An enemy unit charged by a unit with this rule gets no Cover save, and no benefit from a building or fortification, for the rest of that Combat.

rules.name: Shaped Charge
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in the Assault phase, the bearer's melee attacks gain Breaching (3+) until the end of that Combat.

rules.name: Unyielding Bastion
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy units that charge a unit with this rule subtract 1 from their Charge rolls.

rules.name: Ablative Layers
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Unsaved Wound the bearer suffers in each battle is discarded.

rules.name: Siege Calculus
rules.text: Legacy house rule. At the start of each Shooting phase choose one enemy unit within 24" of the bearer. Friendly Iron Warriors units add 1 to their Hit Tests against it until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Sapper Tunnels
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A unit with this rule gains Infiltrate (9), but subtracts 1 from its Cool Checks while an enemy unit is within 6".

rules.name: Spall Liners
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The vehicle ignores the Stunned and Suppressed Statuses inflicted by Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Fixed-Fire Protocol
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The automaton adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill if it did not move this turn.

rites.name: The Bastion Doctrine
rites.flavor: A line that cannot be turned is worth more than ten that cannot be stopped.
benefits: Iron Havocs, Heavy Support Squads and Tactical Support Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Dug In: after a turn in which they did not move, they count as in Cover against Shooting Attacks and add +1 to their Cool Checks.
limitations: No Antigrav units, no Fast Attack units, and no Recon units other than Tarantula Batteries.
Units with Dug In may not start the battle in Reserves.

modifiers.text: The Bastion Doctrine: Line (1), Dug In.

rites.name: Iron Circle Garrison
rites.flavor: Perturabo trusts no one, and so every wall he builds has a guard on the inside.
benefits: Iron Circle Maniples and Dominator Cohorts may fill Troops slots.
Those units gain Unbroken Garrison: they automatically pass Cool Checks and Pinning Checks while within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith.
limitations: Perturabo, a Warsmith or a Warsmith in Artificer armour must lead the army.
Units with Unbroken Garrison may not voluntarily Fall Back.
No Recon, Fast Attack or Heavy Assault units, and at most one Armour unit.

require.note: Perturabo or a Warsmith must lead the army.

rites.name: The Cold Calculus
rites.flavor: A machine does not flinch, and it does not need to be thanked.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellax gain Machine Certainty: they ignore Fear (X) and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: At least two Castellax Battle Maniples are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Cold Calculus: Line (1), Machine Certainty.

require.note: Bring at least two Castellax Battle Maniples.

rites.name: Breach and Clear
rites.flavor: The guns open the wall. Then the armour walks through the hole.
benefits: Tyrant Siege Terminators, Tartaros Terminator Siege Squads, Tartaros Terminator Squads and Veteran Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Move Through Cover.
Those units gain Through the Breach: enemy units they charge gain no benefit from Cover or fortifications in that Combat.
limitations: At least two of those siege infantry squads are required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Breach and Clear: Line (1), Through the Breach, Move Through Cover.

require.note: Bring at least two siege infantry squads.
